first_reader_said: NEH 6:18: Both records hold Arah as the father of Shecaniah, Tobiah's father-in-law; B adds the house of Arah from Ezra 2:5.

why: Both records identify Arah as the father of the same Shecaniah, Tobiah’s father-in-law, in NEH 6:18. A additionally holds the family lists in EZR 2:5 and NEH 7:10; B supplies no distinct ancestry, generation, or role and is a thinner copy of A.
